set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/posix-shell-installer
work=$(mktemp -d '/tmp/report installer verify.XXXXXX')
destination="$work/branch reports/october"
printf '%s\n' '## first install to a path containing spaces'
/bin/sh bin/install-report "$destination"
cmp templates/summary.txt "$destination/summary.txt"
cmp templates/detail.txt "$destination/detail.txt"
cmp launcher "$destination/run-report"
test -x "$destination/run-report"
printf '%s\n' 'content comparisons: PASS' 'launcher executable: PASS'
sha256sum templates/summary.txt "$destination/summary.txt" templates/detail.txt "$destination/detail.txt" launcher "$destination/run-report"
"$destination/run-report"
printf '%s\n' '## repeat install'
/bin/sh bin/install-report "$destination"
cmp templates/summary.txt "$destination/summary.txt"
cmp templates/detail.txt "$destination/detail.txt"
cmp launcher "$destination/run-report"
test -x "$destination/run-report"
printf '%s\n' 'repeat installation: PASS'
printf '%s\n' '## unpopulatable destination must fail'
printf '%s\n' blocker > "$work/not-a-directory"
if /bin/sh bin/install-report "$work/not-a-directory/child" >"$work/failure.stdout" 2>"$work/failure.stderr"; then
    printf '%s\n' 'unexpected success' >&2
    exit 1
else
    failure_rc=$?
fi
printf 'failure exit code: %s\n' "$failure_rc"
sed -n '1,80p' "$work/failure.stderr"
test "$failure_rc" -ne 0
printf '%s\n' 'failure reporting: PASS'
rm -rf "$work"
